description: This file defines classes and templates for reading and processing JSON-based IR (Intermediate Representation) data structures in a compiler or code analysis tool. It includes JSON parsing utilities and specific IR representation methods.

classes.name: JsonObjectRef
classes.description: A class for read-only access to JSON objects, providing methods to retrieve typed values by key.

classes.name: JsonArrayRef
classes.description: A template class for read-only access to JSON arrays, with iterators to traverse elements.

classes.name: JsonIRReader
classes.description: A class inheriting from IRReader that loads IR data from JSON files, including methods to parse different IR components.

methods.name: GetBool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value for a given key from a JSON object.

methods.name: GetInt
methods.description: Retrieves an integer value for a given key from a JSON object.

methods.name: GetUint
methods.description: Retrieves an unsigned integer value for a key.

methods.name: GetIntegralValue
methods.description: Retrieves a reference to an integral JSON value.

methods.name: GetString
methods.description: Retrieves a string value for a given key.

methods.name: GetObject
methods.description: Retrieves a nested JSON object for a given key.

methods.name: GetObjects
methods.description: Retrieves an array of JSON objects for a given key.

methods.name: GetStrings
methods.description: Retrieves an array of strings for a given key.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Dereference operator for JSON array iterator returning the current element.

methods.name: Iterator begin() const
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the start of the JSON array.

methods.name: Iterator end() const
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the end of the JSON array.

methods.name: ReadDumpImpl
methods.description: Implements the logic to read and parse the dump file into IR.

methods.name: ReadFunctions
methods.description: Parses function definitions from JSON.

methods.name: ReadGlobalVariables
methods.description: Parses global variable definitions from JSON.

methods.name: ReadEnumTypes
methods.description: Parses enum type definitions from JSON.

methods.name: ReadRecordTypes
methods.description: Parses record (struct/class) type definitions.

methods.name: ReadFunctionTypes
methods.description: Parses function type definitions.

methods.name: ReadPointerTypes
methods.description: Parses pointer type definitions.

methods.name: ReadBuiltinTypes
methods.description: Parses built-in type definitions.

methods.name: ReadQualifiedTypes
methods.description: Parses qualified type information.

methods.name: ReadArrayTypes
methods.description: Parses array type definitions.

methods.name: ReadLvalueReferenceTypes
methods.description: Parses lvalue reference types.

methods.name: ReadRvalueReferenceTypes
methods.description: Parses rvalue reference types.

methods.name: ReadElfFunctions
methods.description: Parses ELF-specific functions.

methods.name: ReadElfObjects
methods.description: Parses ELF-specific objects.

methods.name: ReadTemplateInfo
methods.description: Reads template-related information from JSON and populates IR structures.

methods.name: ReadTypeInfo
methods.description: Reads detailed type information.

methods.name: ReadRecordFields
methods.description: Reads fields of record types.

methods.name: ReadBaseSpecifiers
methods.description: Reads base class specifiers for record types.

methods.name: ReadVTableLayout
methods.description: Reads virtual table layout data.

methods.name: ReadEnumFields
methods.description: Reads enum fields.

methods.name: ReadFunctionParametersAndReturnType
methods.description: Reads function parameters and return type info.

methods.name: FunctionJsonToIR
methods.description: Converts JSON representation of a function to IR.

methods.name: FunctionTypeJsonToIR
methods.description: Converts JSON function type to IR.

methods.name: RecordTypeJsonToIR
methods.description: Converts JSON record type to IR.

methods.name: EnumTypeJsonToIR
methods.description: Converts JSON enum type to IR.
